profile.headline: Front-End Web Developer II at Johnson Health Tech North America
profile.summary:
🌐 Front-End Web Developer II at Johnson Health Tech North America

With over a decade of experience in the realm of web development, I've honed my skills to become proficient in crafting intuitive and dynamic user interfaces. My journey of twelve years has been a testament to my dedication and passion for the ever-evolving world of web technologies.


🔧 Skills & Expertise:

Proficient in Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, and various JavaScript frameworks.
Adept at using Git, Bitbucket, and the Jira product suite, ensuring seamless collaboration and efficient project management.


🎓 Education:

Associate's Degree


🌟 Philosophy:

"Be better than yesterday." This motto drives me daily, pushing me to constantly evolve, learn, and improve.


🎯 Goals:

Short-Term: Dive deep into DevExtreme to further enhance my toolkit.
Long-Term: Transition into a full-stack developer role, expanding my horizons and taking on new challenges.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer II
positions.description:
Lead new projects by identifying the necessary front-end technologies.

Developing and maintaining consumer-facing websites using Angular, TypeScript, SCSS/CSS for global Strategic Business Units (SBUs).

Developing and maintaining web applications, and native mobile applications, to bolster the internal sales department's product sales efforts.
